answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprinting (ELBF): each agent carries a rolling action-transition and counterparty-cluster vector. At every epoch boundary, compare it with prior-epoch centroids; identities that wander outside a calibrated tolerance grove enter a hollow quarantine, blocking scarce task routing until they re-accumulate consistent history. A sybil farm must simulate coherent histories across epochs for every identity, paying coordination, latency, and lost routing yield; fresh agents have no prior vector and stay quarantined.
